subject.title: fix: make Back work within channel setup

question: Should channel setup adapters use the shared `beforePersistentEffect` callback as the authoritative boundary after which terminal Back navigation is disabled?
rationale: This defines the durable-work contract for shared and custom setup adapters; the patch can implement either direction, but the permanent adapter policy requires owner intent.

options.title: Confirm the shared boundary
options.body: Approve the callback as the adapter contract, document its persistence meaning if needed, and keep this scoped navigation design.

options.title: Require adapter-specific opt-in
options.body: Restrict scoped Back navigation to adapters that explicitly declare replay-safe persistence timing before enabling it broadly.

recommendation.title: Confirm the shared boundary
recommendation.body: Approve the callback as the adapter contract, document its persistence meaning if needed, and keep this scoped navigation design.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the active contributor on both this scoped navigation work and the related shared setup cancellation contract.
